script.code:
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(g.delivery_no, ''), CAST(g.id AS CHAR)) AS gd_no
  FROM goods_delivery g
 WHERE g.tenant_id = '{{system:tenantId}}'
   AND g.id IN ({{node:code_node_GdBusyIds.data.gdIdSql}})
   AND g.is_deleted = 0
   AND (g.gd_status = 'Processing'
                OR EXISTS (SELECT 1
                             FROM gd_async_job j
                            WHERE j.tenant_id = g.tenant_id
                              AND j.is_deleted = 0
                              AND j.command IN ('EDIT_GD', 'COMPLETE_GD', 'COMPLETE_PACKING')
                              AND j.correlation_id = CONCAT('GD|', g.id) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci
                              AND j.job_status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED')))
 LIMIT 1

script.code:
SELECT CAST(gl.id AS CHAR) AS gd_line_id,
       gl.gd_qty,
       COALESCE(NULLIF(g.delivery_no, ''), CAST(g.id AS CHAR)) AS delivery_no,
       COALESCE(NULLIF(gl.material_name, ''), CAST(gl.id AS CHAR)) AS item_name,
       COALESCE(o.covered, 0) AS covered,
       o.pickings
  FROM JSON_TABLE(CONCAT('[', '{{node:code_node_CoverIds.data.lineIdCsv}}', ']'), '$[*]' COLUMNS (lid BIGINT PATH '$')) l
  JOIN goods_delivery_fwii8mvb_sub gl ON gl.id = l.lid AND gl.tenant_id = '{{system:tenantId}}'
  JOIN goods_delivery g ON g.id = gl.goods_delivery_id
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT x.gd_line_id, SUM(x.qty) AS covered, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT x.to_no ORDER BY x.to_no SEPARATOR ', ') AS pickings
               FROM (SELECT i.gd_line_id, i.qty_to_pick AS qty, t.to_id AS to_no
                       FROM transfer_order t
                       JOIN transfer_order_jz8m9w3h_sub i ON i.transfer_order_id = t.id AND i.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND i.is_deleted = 0
                      WHERE t.tenant_id = '{{system:tenantId}}'
                        AND t.is_deleted = 0
                        AND t.to_status NOT IN ('Completed', 'Cancelled', 'Draft')
                        AND t.id NOT IN ({{node:code_node_CoverIds.data.ownIdCsv}})
                        AND COALESCE(i.line_status, '') <> 'Cancelled'
                        AND COALESCE(i.row_type, '') <> 'header'
                        AND (JSON_OVERLAPS(t.gd_no, CAST(CONCAT('[', '{{node:code_node_CoverIds.data.gdIdCsv}}', ']') AS JSON))
                             OR JSON_OVERLAPS(t.gd_no, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(CAST(d.id AS CHAR))
                                                          FROM JSON_TABLE(CONCAT('[', '{{node:code_node_CoverIds.data.gdIdCsv}}', ']'),
                                                                          '$[*]' COLUMNS (id BIGINT PATH '$')) d)))
                     UNION ALL
                     SELECT r.gd_line_id, COALESCE(r.store_out_qty, 0) AS qty, t.to_id AS to_no
                       FROM transfer_order t
                       JOIN transfer_order_vrqs3cmr_sub r ON r.transfer_order_id = t.id AND r.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND r.is_deleted = 0
                      WHERE t.tenant_id = '{{system:tenantId}}'
                        AND t.is_deleted = 0
                        AND t.to_status = 'Completed'
                        AND t.id NOT IN ({{node:code_node_CoverIds.data.ownIdCsv}})
                        AND (JSON_OVERLAPS(t.gd_no, CAST(CONCAT('[', '{{node:code_node_CoverIds.data.gdIdCsv}}', ']') AS JSON))
                             OR JSON_OVERLAPS(t.gd_no, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(CAST(d.id AS CHAR))
                                                          FROM JSON_TABLE(CONCAT('[', '{{node:code_node_CoverIds.data.gdIdCsv}}', ']'),
                                                                          '$[*]' COLUMNS (id BIGINT PATH '$')) d)))) x
              GROUP BY x.gd_line_id) o ON o.gd_line_id = gl.id

script.code:
SELECT id,
       to_status,
       COALESCE(is_processing, 0) AS is_processing,
       TIMESTAMPDIFF(
           SECOND,
           update_time,
           CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), '+00:00', '+08:00')
       ) AS lock_age_sec,
       (SELECT CONCAT(CAST(j.id AS CHAR), '|', j.job_status)
          FROM gd_async_job j
         WHERE j.tenant_id = t.tenant_id
           AND j.command = 'CONFIRM_PICKING'
           AND j.picking_id = '{{node:code_node_hjAwTKzF.data.lockId}}'
           AND j.is_deleted = 0
           AND j.job_status IN ('QUEUED', 'VALIDATING', 'READY_TO_COMMIT', 'COMMITTING_PICKING', 'REQUIRES_REVIEW')
         ORDER BY j.id DESC
         LIMIT 1) AS open_job
FROM transfer_order t
WHERE id = '{{node:code_node_hjAwTKzF.data.lockId}}'
  AND is_deleted = 0
LIMIT 1

script.code:
SELECT CAST('gd' AS CHAR) AS kind, CAST(g.id AS CHAR) AS id, CAST(COALESCE(g.picking_status, '') AS CHAR) AS picking_status
FROM JSON_TABLE(CONCAT('[', '{{node:code_node_1HuvfKMv.data.gdIdCsv}}', ']'), '$[*]' COLUMNS (rid BIGINT PATH '$')) j
JOIN goods_delivery g ON g.id = j.rid AND g.is_deleted = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT CAST('gd_line' AS CHAR), CAST(l.id AS CHAR), CAST(COALESCE(l.picking_status, '') AS CHAR)
FROM JSON_TABLE(CONCAT('[', '{{node:code_node_1HuvfKMv.data.gdLineIdCsv}}', ']'), '$[*]' COLUMNS (rid BIGINT PATH '$')) j
JOIN goods_delivery_fwii8mvb_sub l ON l.id = j.rid AND l.is_deleted = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT CAST('pp' AS CHAR), CAST(p.id AS CHAR), CAST(COALESCE(p.picking_status, '') AS CHAR)
FROM JSON_TABLE(CONCAT('[', '{{node:code_node_1HuvfKMv.data.toIdCsv}}', ']'), '$[*]' COLUMNS (rid BIGINT PATH '$')) j
JOIN picking_plan p ON p.id = j.rid AND p.is_deleted = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT CAST('pp_line' AS CHAR), CAST(l.id AS CHAR), CAST(COALESCE(l.picking_status, '') AS CHAR)
FROM JSON_TABLE(CONCAT('[', '{{node:code_node_1HuvfKMv.data.toLineIdCsv}}', ']'), '$[*]' COLUMNS (rid BIGINT PATH '$')) j
JOIN picking_plan_fwii8mvb_sub l ON l.id = j.rid AND l.is_deleted = 0
